##### Project general facts

Lincoln Star Residence 2 is an elegant new residential address that builds beautifully on the success of the original Lincoln Star Residence, carrying forward the same spirit of innovation and forward-thinking design. The development brings together a boutique collection of studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, along with a very special selection of three-bedroom duplexes that are internally connected across two levels. Gentle pastel hues, sweeping curved balconies and a grand entrance lobby filled with natural light create an ambience of calm serenity from the very first moment you arrive.

Residents are treated to a wonderful rooftop world of amenities designed for every mood and every member of the family. There is a sparkling swimming pool and jacuzzi, a state-of-the-art gym, a soothing halotherapy room, a yoga area, a jogging path, a garden walk and an open activity area for those who love to stay moving. Families will adore the children's play area, the kitchen garden, the multi-purpose events space and the BBQ area, all supported by a welcoming community centre, a buggy facility and round-the-clock security.

Step inside and the interiors reveal a warm, refined palette of rich timber joinery, softly illuminated cabinetry and beautifully veined marble that lends every room a sense of quiet luxury. The open-plan living and dining spaces are anchored by striking marble feature walls, while floor-to-ceiling glazing and sheer drapery invite light to pour in and flow out onto generous balconies. Kitchens are finished with elegant stone worktops, full-height marble splashbacks and integrated under-cabinet lighting, and the bathrooms continue the same story with fluted detailing, walk-in rain showers and polished brushed-gold fittings.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South - is a dynamic and strategically planned district located in the southern part of Dubai. It serves as a major hub for economic, commercial, and logistical activities, designed with a vision to support the growth of various industries. One of its standout features is its proximity to the Al Maktoum International Airport, the world's largest airport in terms of cargo volume, making it a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

In addition to its logistical prowess, Dubai South is home to the Dubai Expo 2020 site, which served as a testament to the district's capacity to host large-scale global events. The Expo site has now transitioned into a legacy district, offering a wide range of amenities and infrastructure, including residential communities, educational institutions, and recreational facilities. Dubai South's commitment to sustainability is evident in its green initiatives, with a focus on eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings.

Dubai South continues to grow as a thriving business and residential hub, attracting both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for businesses and individuals alike, contributing to the ongoing development and economic diversification of Dubai.
